sources.note: Reverse engineering help page; WebFetch extraction (paraphrase)

claims.statement: The mapping dialog groups items as Mapped Relations, Tables and Views, with relations labelled when they have unmapped columns.
claims.supports: left panel groups Mapped Relations, Tables, Views; labeled when they have unmapped columns
claims.surfaceEquivalent: Headless on the SURFACE equivalent: Designer Create tab, 'From database / SQL' panel groups the relations of a SQL file as Mapped Relations / Tables / Views (compared with the project's entity scan) and labels a mapped relation 'N unmapped columns'. Verified by unit test designer::tests::reverse_inventory_groups_relations_labels_unmapped_columns_and_lists_references and scripts/check-jpa-designer.mjs. Not checked: the original's modal dialog layout; the source is a SQL file (a saved connection is listed but never read by the panel); starting the mapping stays a code action the web view cannot run.

claims.statement: The right panel groups Mapped Columns, Columns and References.
claims.supports: right panel groups Mapped Columns, Columns, References
claims.surfaceEquivalent: Headless on the SURFACE equivalent: the panel's right side lists Mapped Columns, Columns and References of the selected relation; references are shown even when the table has no matching column (columnPresent=false). Verified by the same unit test and the Designer browser check. Not checked: the original dialog layout; no live database.

undocumented: DDL-text parsing as the schema source (docs use a live DB connection)
